cut.analysisHelpers:
# Diagnostic only: complete the real Plan before returning the same original BIR.
# The generated CPS call graph is checked before canonical native validation.
def transport_analysis_done(planned: Plan, original: BIR.Program) -> BIR.Program:
  match planned:
    case Plan{fresh, producers, order, expansions, consumers}: original

def transport_analysis(+program: BIR.Program) -> BIR.Program:
  match program:
    case BIR.Program{+codes, +declarations, +constructors, +families, +type_functions, +end}:
      +fresh = program_bounds(codes, declarations, end)
      +codes_map = code_map(codes, Map.new(&2, BIR.Code))
      +candidates = candidate_map(codes, Map.new(&2, Cand))
      +plan = Plan{fresh, Map.new(&2, Producer), Nil{}, Map.new(&2, Expansion), Nil{}}
      transport_analysis_done(plan_program(codes, declarations, candidates, codes_map, plan), program)

preservedSetupFailure.reason: Nested independent exclusive guardians; the inner native builder already owns the required guardian

decision.E05: GO bounded existing-BIR direct-field specialization, then actual source semantics, full root, fixedpoint, original performance policy and consumers. This diagnostic is not evidence of speedup.
decision.validation: RETAIN both original width validations; equal hashes/width outputs on unchanged-analysis do not authorize skipping validation in a rewritten program.
decision.generalMailbox: No promotion of rejected G32; discovery/planning constructs workers even in analysis cut. Pure abstract-analysis allocation/cost is not isolated.

limitations: Native pass subintervals and native BIR object identities are not measured by this source-cut run
Identical frozen workload and equal pre-emitter source plus cross-executor exact output checks; the JS suite supplies measured same-BIR hashes
Native generation/validation/build costs are separate from native compiler emission timings
No C edits, bypassed checks, ownership shim, forced GC or accepted-compiler promotion
Plan includes worker body construction; no pure-analysis allocation estimate
Structural hashing and source-entry counters perturb timing; no acceptance claim
Full rewrite renderer consumes transformed BIR, not identical renderer input; unchanged/analysis renderer inputs are identical
Single diagnostic execution per mode/lane, not an unprofiled paired qualification series.
Observed JS timing intervals include source counters, fingerprint boundaries, JIT and completion overhead; no pure cost or retained-byte inference.
Frozen source inputs are source-only content, not generated executable/JS/C images, AST transports, profiles or bulk logs.
